basic_info.description:
Welcome to 238 Hearst Avenue, a charming 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom home in Sunnyside, San Francisco. Spanning 1,000 sq. ft., this cozy home features a spacious backyard and has recently undergone stylish renovations. The bathroom has been updated with a modern vanity, quartz countertop, new fixtures, exhaust fan, and mirror, while the kitchen boasts new cabinets, quartz countertops, a backsplash, and stainless steel appliances for a sleek look. Updated lighting and Arctic White switches and plates add a polished touch.

Ideally located, this home offers quick access to Glen Park BART and bus lines, making commutes effortless. Its also near top-rated schools, including Sunnyside Elementary, Balboa High, and City College of San Francisco. Sunnysides amenities, like Balboa Park, Sunnyside Playground, and the nearby shops and dining of Monterey Boulevard, offer a vibrant neighborhood experience. This updated, well-located home is ready to welcome you!
